profile.details: The system correctly identifies core profile elements (email, name, preferred name, languages, language variant, default tone, semi-formal greetings). However, several issues reduce quality: (1) The signature title is merged ('Chef de projet - Division Digitale') rather than kept as separate title/department fields — though department is also present separately, so this is minor. (2) Closing styles are notably wrong: 'semi_formal_fr' should be 'Merci,' not 'Cordialement,'; 'formal_fr' should be 'Cordialement,' (correct here but misassigned label); 'semi_formal_en' should be 'Best,' not 'Best regards,'; 'formal_en' should be 'Best regards,' (correct); 'casual_fr' should be '(no closing or just name)' — the system outputs 'Sophie' which is partially correct but imprecise. (3) The 'casual_fr' greeting style is missing entirely. (4) 'uses_emoji: false' is missing. (5) 'addressing' field is placed inside tone as 'vous' rather than at root level as 'mixed'. (6) 'average_response_length' is 'medium-long' vs ground truth 'medium'. (7) Extra fields like 'profession', 'profession_confirmed' are added but not harmful. The closing style errors are the most impactful for email drafting quality.

knowledge.details: The system found all 13 ground truth contacts plus one hallucinated contact (support@cloudprovider.com). However, the system systematically dropped all job titles (set to null for every contact), which is a significant data loss. Company names are sometimes truncated/simplified (e.g., 'ClientCorp SA' → 'ClientCorp', 'GlobalTech Inc.' → 'GlobalTech', 'Maintenance Pro SARL' → null). One contact (Amelie Petit) has wrong preferred_tone ('semi-formal' instead of 'formal') and missing company. Thomas Renard's company is missing. Pierre Durand's title ('Lead Developer') is missing. The system adds a 'language_variant' field not in ground truth, which is harmless but unnecessary. Core tone preferences are mostly correct (12/13 correct tones, with Amelie Petit being wrong). The hallucinated contact (CloudProvider Support) reduces precision. The missing titles would reduce usefulness when drafting emails requiring appropriate salutations or context.

rules.details: The system found all 14 contacts present in the ground truth, which is good for completeness. However, several contact rules have errors: pierre.durand is marked 'semi-formal' instead of 'casual', camille.roux is marked 'semi-formal' instead of 'casual', nicolas.moreau is marked 'formal' instead of 'semi-formal' with wrong addressing ('vous' instead of 'tu'), ceo@techcorp.fr is marked 'formal' instead of 'semi-formal' with wrong addressing ('vous' instead of implied tu/first-name basis), contact@prospect-startup.io is marked 'formal' instead of 'semi-formal'. The greeting for marie.leclerc incorrectly merges Claire Fontaine's name ('bonjour Claire'). The general rules are present but in a degraded format — they lack structured fields (name, trigger, action) making them harder to use programmatically. The system adds some useful extra rules (jargon usage, meeting slot proposals, attachment practices) not in ground truth, which are plausible but unverified. The ground truth's explicit tutoiement/vouvoiement rules and CC/action-item rules are partially captured but not fully structured. Missing: explicit cc_relevant_people rule, explicit action_items rule with 'Actions a suivre' section trigger.
